# Design Notes: Molaris (Toothcare recreation)

- **Source**: ColorLib Toothcare (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/toothcare/`)
- **Aesthetic**: Clean, professional medical/dental clinic styling featuring calming teal `#00bcd4` primary accents, dark charcoal text, and crisp white cards.
- **Color Palette**:
  - Primary / Accent: `#00bcd4` (Teal)
  - Dark / Header: `#111111`
  - Backgrounds: `#ffffff` (cards), `#f8f9fa` (light sections)
- **Typography**: Roboto / sans-serif with strong uppercase subtitles (`tracking-wider text-xs font-bold text-teal-500`).
- **Layout Rhythm**: Alternating white and light gray sections, multi-column card grids for services, team members, blog posts, and pricing.
- **Key Interactive Elements**: Appointment booking form, tabs/sliders for hero and testimonials, interactive modals or card hovers for doctor bios.
